note.fr: Fournir un diplôme d'études secondaires (ou équivalent) donnant accès à l'enseignement supérieur. Les certificats acceptés (GCE A-level, IB ou équivalent, min. deux matières) et les scores minimaux (p. ex. GED 175+) doivent être vérifiés au cas par cas. Les GCE O-level, GCSE, IGCSE, GCE AS et BTEC ne sont pas acceptés.
note.en: Provide a secondary school diploma (or equivalent) allowing direct access to higher education. Accepted certificates (GCE A-level, IB or equivalent, min. two subjects) and minimum scores (e.g. GED 175+) must be checked case by case. GCE O-level, GCSE, IGCSE, GCE AS and BTEC are not accepted.

evidence.quote: For the International Business Economics BA programme, the application of those students is welcome who have completed their secondary school studies and can provide proof of this by presenting a secondary or high school diploma (or equivalent), which allows direct access to tertiary/higher education, i.e., with this document the applicant should be eligible to study at university level.
General Certificate of Education Advanced level (GCE A-level) or International Baccalaurate (IB) exams, or equivalent, in minimum two subjects.
Due to the character of the programmes, exams in the following subjects are highly desirable: Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Economics, Business studies, Accounting, Computer science, History.
In case of equivalent exams, for example, GED, the minimum required scores are 175+ to be considered as a potential applicant.
